title: Code for: Is the Clinical Brain Window Optimal for AI? A Systematic Grid Search of CT Windowing for Deep-Learning Stroke Classification on Non-Contrast CT
description:
Code for the paper Is the Clinical Brain Window Optimal for AI? A Systematic Grid Search of CT Windowing for Deep-Learning Stroke Classification on Non-Contrast CT (A. Kaban, M. Karakaya).

The study trains four architectures (ResNet-50, DenseNet-121, EfficientNet-B0, MobileViTv2-175) on two binary tasks (normal vs. ischemic, normal vs. hemorrhagic) and compares windowed inputs. Experiment A compares raw HU input (split-wide min-max scaling) with the clinical brain window (WW = 80, WC = 40). Experiment B evaluates every window of a 22 x 16 grid (WW 10-220 HU, WC 0-150 HU, steps of 10 HU) against the clinical window. Each configuration is trained with five seeds.

The repository contains the code for data preparation, training, statistical analysis and figures. No data, result files or model weights are included.
